# App Store

> Apple's App Store is the primary marketplace for discovering, browsing, and downloading apps and games across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro.

The App Store serves as Apple's curated digital storefront featuring trending applications, games, and subscription services like Apple Arcade. It includes editorial content, app recommendations, and collections across multiple Apple platforms.

## Key Topics

- App Store
- iPhone
- iPad
- Apple Arcade
- Apple TV
- Apple Watch
- Apple Vision Pro
- iOS apps
- Games
- App recommendations
- Trending apps
- New releases
- Featured collections
- Free-to-play
- Puzzle games

## Platform Hubs

- [Today for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/today): App Store Today tab featuring trending apps, games, and new releases for iPhone
- [Today for iPad - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/ipad/today): App Store Today tab with curated app and game recommendations for iPad
- [Apps for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/apps): App Store apps category for iPhone with featured and must-have applications
- [Games for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/games): App Store games category browsing for iPhone with featured and trending titles
- [Apps for Watch - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/watch/apps-and-games): App Store collection of watchOS apps for Apple Watch including fitness and wellness
- [Discover for TV - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/tv/discover): App Store discovery page for Apple TV apps, streaming services, and Apple Arcade

## Apple Arcade & Immersive Experiences

- [Arcade for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/arcade): Apple Arcade game catalog for iPhone with subscription games and top titles
- [Apps & Games for Vision - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/vision/apps-and-games): App Store catalog for Apple Vision Pro with immersive mixed reality apps
